Name: Apple iPhone 15 (128 GB, Pink)
Short Description: 48MP camera, Dynamic Island and A16 Bionic in the much-loved Pink finish.
Description: iPhone 15 brings the 48MP main camera with super-high-resolution photos, Dynamic Island and the A16 Bionic chip, wrapped in durable colour-infused glass and aerospace-grade aluminium. The Pink finish is the crowd favourite at our Rajpur Road store — pair it with a pink case and AirPods for the complete look.

Name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro (128 GB, Natural Titanium)
Short Description: Titanium build, A17 Pro chip and a 48MP Pro camera system with 5x zoom.
Description: iPhone 15 Pro is the lightest Pro ever, with a aerospace-grade titanium design, the A17 Pro chip for console-class gaming and a Pro camera system that shoots 48MP ProRAW and 4K cinematic video. The Action button puts your favourite shortcut one press away.
Colors: Natural Titanium | Blue Titanium | White Titanium | Black Titanium

Name: Samsung Galaxy S24 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Amber Yellow)
Short Description: Compact flagship with Galaxy AI, 50MP camera and a bright 120Hz display.
Description: Galaxy S24 packs the Exynos 2400 processor, a 6.2-inch FHD+ 120Hz display and a versatile 50MP triple camera. Galaxy AI features like Circle to Search, Live Translate and Chat Assist make everyday tasks effortless.
Colors: Amber Yellow | Onyx Black | Marble Grey | Violet

Name: Samsung Galaxy S24 FE 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Navy)
Short Description: Fan Edition flagship experience — 50MP camera, 120Hz display and Galaxy AI.
Description: The Galaxy S24 FE brings the flagship experience to a friendlier price: a 6.7-inch 120Hz display, 50MP OIS camera, Exynos 2400e and the full Galaxy AI suite. A brilliant choice for students and creators.

Name: Samsung Galaxy M35 5G (6 GB + 128 GB, Thunder Grey)
Short Description: 6000 mAh battery, 50MP OIS camera and a smooth 120Hz Super AMOLED.
Description: Galaxy M35 5G is built for marathon users: a 6000 mAh battery, Exynos 1380 processor, 50MP OIS camera and a 6.6-inch 120Hz Super AMOLED display with Vision Booster. Knox security and 4 years of OS updates included.
Colors: Thunder Grey | Daylight Blue | Hazel Blush

Name: OnePlus Nord CE4 Lite 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Mega Blue)
Short Description: 80W SUPERVOOC charging, 120Hz AMOLED and a 50MP Sony camera.
Description: Nord CE4 Lite 5G charges from 0 to 100% in about 45 minutes with 80W SUPERVOOC. It pairs a 6.67-inch 120Hz AMOLED display with a 50MP Sony LYT-600 main camera and a large 5500 mAh battery.

Name: OnePlus 12R (16 GB + 256 GB, Cool Blue)
Short Description: Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, 100W charging and a 120Hz ProXDR display.
Description: OnePlus 12R delivers flagship speed with the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, 16 GB RAM and a 5500 mAh battery that charges at 100W. The 6.78-inch ProXDR display hits 4500 nits peak brightness for effortless outdoor use.

Name: Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Coral Purple)
Short Description: 200MP OIS camera, 120Hz AMOLED and 67W fast charging.
Description: Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G features a 200MP OIS main camera, Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 and a 6.67-inch 1.5K CrystalView AMOLED at 120Hz. The 5100 mAh battery with 67W turbo charging keeps you going all day.
Colors: Coral Purple | Midnight Black | Forest Green

Name: realme 12 Pro+ 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Navigator Beige)
Short Description: Periscope 64MP telephoto zoom with a luxury watch-inspired design.
Description: realme 12 Pro+ 5G stands out with its luxury watch-inspired design and a periscope 64MP telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom. The 6.7-inch curved AMOLED runs at 120Hz and charges at 67W SUPERVOOC.
Colors: Navigator Beige | Submarine Blue | Explorer Orange

Name: OPPO Reno 11 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Wave Green)
Short Description: 32MP telephoto portrait camera in an ultra-slim 7.6 mm design.
Description: Reno 11 5G is a portrait photography expert with a 32MP 2x telephoto lens, 50MP main camera and OPPO's HDR portrait engine. The 6.7-inch AMOLED display supports 120Hz and 67W SUPERVOOC charging.

Name: vivo V29 5G (8 GB + 128 GB, Artistic Blue)
Short Description: 50MP Aura Light portrait camera with a colour-changing Artistic Blue back.
Description: vivo V29 5G shines with the Aura Light portrait system, a 50MP front camera and a colour-changing Artistic Blue glass back. The 6.78-inch 120Hz curved AMOLED and 80W flash charge complete the package.
Colors: Artistic Blue | Royal Purple | Starlight Ancient

Name: Motorola Edge 40 Neo (12 GB + 256 GB, Caneel Bay)
Short Description: Pantone-validated colours, pOLED 144Hz display and IP68 protection.
Description: Motorola Edge 40 Neo combines 12 GB RAM, a 6.55-inch pOLED 144Hz display, IP68 water protection and a vegan leather finish in Pantone-validated colours. A 50MP OIS camera and 68W TurboPower charging round it off.
Colors: Caneel Bay | Black Beauty | Soothing Sea

Name: Apple AirPods (3rd Generation) with Lightning Case
Short Description: Personalised Spatial Audio, sweat resistance and up to 30 hours of listening.
Description: AirPods (3rd generation) feature Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, sweat and water resistance and up to 30 hours of total listening time with the Lightning charging case. Instant pairing with every iPhone.
Battery: Up to 6 h + 24 h with case

Name: Samsung Galaxy Buds FE (Graphite)
Short Description: Active Noise Cancellation and 24-bit audio in a comfortable in-ear design.
Description: Galaxy Buds FE deliver Active Noise Cancellation, 24-bit Hi-Fi sound and a comfortable fit for all-day wear. With 30 hours of total battery life and seamless switching between Galaxy devices.
Battery: Up to 8.5 h + 21.5 h with case

Name: boAt Rockerz 255 Pro+ Bluetooth Neckband (Blazing Yellow)
Short Description: 40-hour playback, fast charge and IPX7 sweat resistance.
Description: Rockerz 255 Pro+ is India's favourite neckband with 40 hours of playback, 10-minute fast charge for 10 hours of play and IPX7 water resistance. boAt Signature Sound with bass boost keeps every workout moving.
Colors: Blazing Yellow | Active Black | Navy Blue

Name: boAt Airdopes 141 True Wireless Earbuds (Cyan Cider)
Short Description: 42-hour playback, ENx calling and low-latency gaming mode.
Description: Airdopes 141 offer 42 hours of total playback, ENx environmental noise cancellation for calls and a low-latency BEAST Mode for gaming. Lightweight, pocket-friendly and finished in a fresh Cyan Cider colour.

Name: JBL Tune 510BT Wireless On-Ear Headphones (Pure White)
Short Description: JBL Pure Bass sound with 40 hours of wireless playback.
Description: JBL Tune 510BT headphones deliver JBL Pure Bass sound, 40 hours of battery life and multipoint connectivity so you can switch between phone and laptop without missing a beat. Folds flat for easy carry.

Name: Noise Buds VS104 Truly Wireless Earbuds (Snow White)
Short Description: 40-hour playback, quad mic with ENC and Instacharge case.
Description: Noise Buds VS104 deliver 40 hours of playtime, a quad-mic setup with environmental noise cancellation and Instacharge — 10 minutes of charging gives 150 minutes of playback. Designed and tuned in India.
Colors: Snow White | Jet Black | Cobalt Blue

Name: Mivi Play Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Pastel Pink)
Short Description: Pocket-size 5W speaker with 13-hour battery in a pastel pink shell.
Description: Mivi Play is a palm-sized Bluetooth speaker with surprisingly big sound, 13 hours of battery and a stylish pastel pink fabric finish. Take it to picnics by the Rispana or to a rooftop party in Clems Estate.
Colors: Pastel Pink | Mint Green | Ravishing Red

Name: Apple Watch Series 9 GPS (41 mm, Pink Aluminium with Light Pink Sport Band)
Short Description: S9 SiP, brighter Always-On display and the new Double Tap gesture.
Description: Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the S9 SiP for faster on-device Siri and the Double Tap gesture. Track workouts, sleep, heart rate and blood oxygen — all on a display that's 2x brighter outdoors.

Name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 (40 mm, Graphite)
Short Description: Bigger AMOLED display, advanced sleep coaching and BioActive sensor.
Description: Galaxy Watch 6 features a larger 1.3-inch sAMOLED display, the 3-in-1 BioActive Sensor for heart rate, ECG and body composition, plus personalised sleep coaching. Works best with Galaxy phones.
Battery: Up to 40 hours · WPC fast charge

Name: Noise ColorFit Pro 4 Smart Watch (Rose Pink)
Short Description: 1.96-inch AMOLED, Bluetooth calling and 100+ sports modes.
Description: Noise ColorFit Pro 4 packs a 1.96-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling with a built-in speaker, 100+ sports modes and a 7-day battery. The Rose Pink strap pairs beautifully with the pink iPhone.
Colors: Rose Pink | Jet Black | Deep Wine | Forest Green

Name: boAt Xtend Talk Smart Watch with Bluetooth Calling (Cherry Blossom)
Short Description: 1.85-inch HD display, BT calling, AI voice assistants and 60 sports modes.
Description: boAt Xtend Talk features a 1.85-inch HD display, Bluetooth calling, built-in Alexa and Siri, 60+ sports modes and 7-day battery life. Cherry Blossom is the prettiest strap in the collection.
Colors: Cherry Blossom | Active Black | Cool Blue

Name: Anker 20W Nano Pro Fast Charger (Adapter only)
Short Description: Pocket-size 20W charger that fast-charges iPhone 15 from 0 to 50% in 25 min.
Description: Anker Nano Pro is a thumb-sized 20W charger with ActiveShield 2.0 temperature monitoring. Fast-charges iPhones, Samsung and other USB-C devices. Pair it with a braided cable for the perfect travel kit.

Name: Ambrane 20000 mAh 22.5W Power Bank (Stylo-20K, Pink)
Short Description: 20000 mAh slim power bank with 22.5W fast charging and 12-layer circuit protection.
Description: Ambrane Stylo-20K is a slim 20000 mAh power bank with 22.5W fast charging, dual input (Type-C and Micro) and two USB outputs. Charges a typical phone three to four times — a must for Mussoorie trips.

Name: Ambrane 65W GaN Fast Charger (3 Ports)
Short Description: Charge a laptop, phone and earbuds together with a single GaN charger.
Description: This 65W GaN charger powers laptops, tablets and phones at once through two USB-C and one USB-A port. Compact GaN technology keeps it cool, while BIS certification keeps you safe.

Name: Spigen Tough Armor Back Cover for iPhone 15 (Pink)
Short Description: Dual-layer drop protection with kickstand, made for iPhone 15.
Description: Spigen Tough Armor combines a shock-absorbing TPU interior with a hard PC shell, raised lips for camera and screen protection and a built-in kickstand. Mil-grade drop tested and MagSafe compatible.
Warranty: Manufactured for iPhone — 6 Month Store Warranty

Name: JETech Tempered Glass Screen Guard for iPhone 15 (Pack of 2)
Short Description: 9H hardness, case-friendly edges and free installation at the store.
Description: JETech tempered glass offers 9H hardness, an oleophobic coating and case-friendly edges. Buy it with any phone and we install it free at the counter before you leave.

Name: Samsung 25W USB-C Travel Adapter (White)
Short Description: Official Samsung 25W Super Fast Charging adapter without cable.
Description: Samsung's official 25W USB-C power adapter supports Super Fast Charging on Galaxy phones — charge a Galaxy S24 from empty to over 60% in about 30 minutes.

Name: Portronics Konnect L 1.2 m USB-C to USB-C Braided Cable
Short Description: 60W braided USB-C cable that survives 15,000+ bends.
Description: Konnect L is a 1.2 m braided USB-C to USB-C cable rated for 60W fast charging and 480 Mbps data transfer. Tangle-free nylon jacket and reinforced connectors for everyday rough use.

Name: Dyazo 20W Dual Port Fast Car Charger
Short Description: Compact dual-port car charger with USB-C Power Delivery for hill drives.
Description: Dyazo's 20W dual-port car charger tops up phones and earbuds on the drive to Mussoorie or Rishikesh. Its all-metal body stays cool and the soft LED ring makes it easy to find at night.
